description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Line_Formatted' which extends 'Image_Graph_Line_Solid' to create customizable line styles using an array of colors. It appears to be part of a graph rendering library for creating styled line graphs.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Line_Formatted
classes.description: A user-defined line style class allowing multiple colors to be used for line rendering by extending the basic solid line class.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Line_Formatted
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the line style with a provided array of colors, calling the parent constructor with the first color.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Returns an array representing the line style, including color set to the style array and thickness of the line.
